verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no way to save a custom filtered view or share one by link. Everything Views gather all items of one type across projects onto one page, but that is a fixed aggregate view, not a user-saved filter with a shareable URL. Calendar subscriptions and the API's direct resource URLs are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can save a filtered view of work and share it with a link
